datum: WGS 84 (EPSG:4326). MGRS computed from WGS 84 in-browser and in the pipeline.
footer: Poseidon NARINT concept prototype: open, unclassified public data only. Not an official product of the Department of War, USACE, or the Army Geospatial Center.

labels.MODELED: Computed by this atlas from open inputs with stated formulas and weights. It is a screening aid, not a measurement and not a published result of the cited paper.
labels.ANALYTIC ASSESSMENT: Arithmetic or comparison done by the atlas on cited figures (unit conversions, ratios, proximity). Inputs and method are shown beside it.
labels.OBSERVED: A value reported by the named source, shown as published with its as-of date.
labels.CURATED: Analyst-entered in data/source/. Never changed by feeds; feed findings go to the review queue.

F.label: Facility / permit coordinate
F.desc: Permit, well or discharge-point coordinate from EPA ECHO, Texas RRC, ECCC WSER or ISC. Nominal circular error about 100 m; actual quality varies by record.

M.label: Monitoring-site coordinate
M.desc: Sampling site from WQP or CONAGUA monitoring networks. Nominal about 500 m; WQP stations can carry a stated horizontal accuracy that this atlas does not republish.

G.label: Grid cell aggregate
G.desc: Counts or medians in a 0.1 degree (about 11 km) or 0.25 degree (about 28 km) cell. Position is the cell centre.

C.label: County, HUC8 or state aggregate
C.desc: Statistics for an administrative or hydrologic unit. HUC8 markers use the mean of site coordinates; counties use Census polygons.

A.label: Approximate (centroid) location
A.desc: County-centroid or city-centroid positions, such as PWDB records flagged as approximate and the Longview callout.

E.label: Event / news centroid
E.desc: GDACS event centroid or GDELT geocoded article cluster. Indicative only.

limits.note: Reference limits for comparison, not compliance determinations. Units are mg/L unless noted. 'Aesthetic' / 'secondary' values are not health-based. Verified against the linked pages on 2026-11-04 (searches summarising the pages); confirm in the legal text before relying on them.
